institutions.name: Cardiff and Vale University Health Board

subject: Enquiry regarding historical deaths – William Buckler (1990) and Mary Doreen Williams (1983)
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Medical Examiner Service (South Wales Central),

I am writing to enquire whether any records or references are held in
relation to the following historical deaths that occurred in the Cardiff &
Vale / Llandough area:

1. William (Billy) Buckler
   - Died at Llandough Hospital on or about 29 May 1990, aged 41
   - Reported cause: heart attack

2. Mary Doreen Williams
   - Born 10 August 1913
   - Death registered March 1983, South Glamorgan (Vol 28, Page 3029)

Although these pre-date the current Medical Examiner Service, I would be
grateful if you could advise whether any legacy records, referrals, or
related documentation exist, or direct me to the appropriate archive or
department that may hold such information.

Thank you for your assistance.

Yours faithfully,

Requester
